title: The Minority Attack
summary: Attacking with fewer pawns than your opponent has, on purpose, to manufacture a permanent weakness.

sections.heading: The idea that sounds wrong
sections.body: White has two pawns on the queenside against Black's three, and attacks anyway. The point is not to win material or open lines for an assault — it is to force a structural concession. White pushes b4–b5 and hits c6. Black can capture, leaving a backward pawn on an open file; decline, and White takes on c6 leaving the same weakness. Either way White has created a target that cannot be repaired, and then spends the rest of the game piling up on it.

diagram.caption: The Carlsbad structure. White will play a3, b4, Rb1 and b5, aiming to leave Black with a backward c-pawn.

sections.heading: Why it works
sections.body: A backward pawn on a half-open file is the purest positional target there is: it cannot advance, it cannot be defended by another pawn, and every piece that defends it is tied down. Trading pieces makes it worse, not better, so the defender ends up avoiding trades in a position where trades are the natural relief. Games get won this way fifteen moves after the weakness appears.

sections.heading: Defending against it
sections.body: You have three tries, and choosing between them is the skill. Play ...a6 and ...b5 to stop b5 outright, accepting a queenside bind. Play in the centre with ...Ne4 and ...f5, betting that your activity outruns their slow plan. Or attack the king, since White's pawns have left the queenside and the pieces are all pointed the wrong way. What you must not do is drift: the minority attack beats passivity every time.

sections.heading: Why this is in your syllabus
sections.body: Because it is the plan you will face constantly as a Queen's Gambit Declined player, and because it is the clearest example of what strategy actually is. There are no tactics here. There is a target that does not yet exist, a five-move plan to create it, and twenty moves of technique to exploit it. If 'I have no plan on move twelve' is your problem, this is the cure.
